summary: Final regression before redeploy, run on the preview environment. Backend: 5 of 5 pytest pass. Admin login and /auth/me work. Wrong-code verify-document returns 401 four times in a row (no 429). An empty body returns 422. Doc-upload code create, list (hint only) and delete work. /api/health returns 200. Frontend: all checks pass. The homepage loads news, DAX/S&P market overview, Tagesgeld/Festgeld offers and Kundenstimmen/Erfahrungen, with 0 CORS console errors. The only console errors are expected 401s for anonymous /auth/me-type calls. The career popup does not appear on /dokument-upload, /apply or /onboarding (which redirects to /login), with fresh sessionStorage and a seeded visitor profile. It does appear on /. Admin login works and /admin loads. On Admin > Dokument-Uploads the plaintext code VK76JAPN is visible after create and is still visible after clicking du-refresh, so the iteration_66 bug is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: formular_access._client_ip and storage_files._check_public_upload_rl use the right-most XFF entry. On preview this currently resolves to the public client IP (136.110.146.181 was logged), which is fine. Older fail-log rows show internal 10.49.x.x ingress IPs, though. If the production proxy chain differs, all users behind one ingress pod could share a single fail bucket. Check the logged IPs in production after redeploy.
The career popup only shows once a visitor profile exists in localStorage (kapitalmitte_visitor_profile). This is expected, but worth knowing for QA.
seed_data_creation: None. The TEST_iter67 codes were deleted, and the fail-log rows for the test IP were removed.
